profile.headline: Full Stack Developer / USMC Veteran
profile.summary:
Marine Corps Veteran and currently working as an AWS Software Engineer. 

Technologies:
Languages: Java / Java EE, Node JS, Python, Terraform 
Web: JSON, JavaScript, Angular, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap
Database: SQL, JPA, JDBC, JPQL
APIs: RESTful, JSON
Methodologies: TDD
Frameworks: Spring Boot, Agile
Configuration Management: Git

positions.title: AWS Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Translate application storyboards and use cases into functional applications 
• Design new software using agile/XP/test-driven development 
• Design, build and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code 
• Ensure the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of the applications 
• Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to these problems 
• Help maintain code quality, organization, and automation. 
• Help build and/or transition applications to a container or serverless architectures on AWS 
• Ensuring cross-platform optimization for mobile phones 
• Designing and developing APIs

positions.title: Java Full Stack Developer - Graduate
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented applications in Java, JavaScript, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIs
- Created RESTful microservices
- Designed and implemented relational databases
- Implemented Spring Data JPA repositories
- Designed and implemented front end components with Figma, Angular, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap
- Released applications in one-week sprints and deployed to AWS
- Acted in Scrum Master, DBA, Developer roles
- All work done remotely via Zoom, Trello, and Slack

positions.title: Production Controller
positions.description:
- Reported to Defense Logistics Agency (DLA).
- Managed data needs in support of facility management systems.
- Performed system backup and recovery procedures.
- Trained users in database access.

positions.title: Maintenance Controller
positions.description:
- Planned, directed, and controlled the performance and execution of Aviation Maintenance Department functions at the organizational and intermediate levels.
- Maintained over 100 personnel while directing workflow and ensured 10 F/A-18 fighter jets were prepared for daily flight schedule needs to enable over 10 pilots to obtain multiple accomplishments.

positions.title: Aviation Electrician
positions.description: Lead Technician on F/A-18s A-D to install, remove, inspect, test, maintain, and repair systems, components, and ancillary equipment of installed aircraft electrical systems and related systems.

positions.title: Aviation Electrician
positions.description: Lead Technician on F/A-18s A-D to install, remove, inspect, test, maintain, and repair systems, components, and ancillary equipment of installed aircraft electrical systems and related systems.

positions.title: Avionics Technician II
positions.description: Performed required periodic maintenance and necessary servicing of all aircraft electrical systems while demonstrating the ability to consistently perform assigned maintenance tasks within the quoted or standard CMP time.
